item.title: DiningOut in Atlanta
item.description: Some cities comfort you. Others surprise you. Atlanta does both. As we’ve expanded across the country, telling the stories of America’s most exciting food cities, we couldn’t be more proud to announce the launch of DiningOut Atlanta.
